title.narrative: Gearing up to End TB in Zimbabwe - Zimbabwe (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Zimbabwe, Tuberculosis, The Ministry of Health and Child Care of the Republic of Zimbabwe (MOHCC)This program has the following goals: By 2025, a Zimbabwe “free of TB” with a goal of 80% reduction in TB incidence and mortality. By 2025 to have reduced the incidence of all forms of TB by 80% from 242/100000 in 2015 to 48/100 000. By 2025 to have reduced mortality of all forms of TB by 80% from 40/100000 in 2015 to 8/100 000.. The objectives of this program are: To increase the treatment coverage of drug sensitive TB from 83% in 2018 to 90% by 2025 . To increase the treatment success rate of patients with drug susceptible TB from 83% in 2017 to 90% by 2025 . To achieve universal HIV testing and ART coverage for TB cases by 2021 and sustain coverage through to 2025 . To cumulatively detect 2,267 patients with RR/MDR TB between 2021 and 2025. To increase the treatment success rate of patients with RR/MDR TB from 57% (2016) to 75% by 2025. To decrease the proportion of households facing catastrophic costs due to TB from 80% in 2019 to 50% by 2025

Outcome indicators targets and results for ZWE-T-MOHCCP03
Case notification rate of all forms of TB per 100,000 population - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse cases
Notification of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases – Percentage of notified cases of bacteriologically confirmed, drug resistant RR-TB and/or MDR-TB as a proportion of all estimated RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases
Treatment success rate of all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse
